head: 94c013506f5d782870868bfb0d65ff43ba74ca95
summary: The permissions.deny list only blocks the Edit tool from touching guardrail files (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml), but permissions.allow grants unrestricted `Bash(git *)`, so any Claude session (build, test, fix, review) can overwrite those same files via git (e.g. `git checkout <ref> -- CLAUDE.md`, `git show <ref>:sdlc.yaml > sdlc.yaml`, or a direct commit+push) without ever invoking the denied Edit tool, defeating the 'owner changes guardrails only in a reviewed PR' policy stated in CLAUDE.md.
